## Summary
A brief 1-2 sentence explanation of the proposed change or extension.

## Motivation & Problem
What specific agent failure mode, ambiguity, or workflow breakdown does this proposal address?

## Proposed Specification Change
Detailed proposal. Include state machine transitions, Markdown schema modifications, or behavioral rules.

## Axiom Alignment
How does this change align with the core IPP axioms?
- [ ] Preserves `Shaped != Granted` (No unauthorized execution)
- [ ] Maintains Raw Intent Immutability
- [ ] Explicitly layers Facts vs. AI Hypotheses
- [ ] Retains Plaintext Living Markdown as the single source of truth

## Drawbacks & Alternatives Considered
What are the trade-offs of this change? What alternatives were explored?
